scenes.heading: Avoiding the scams and guru courses in this space

sents.d: Avoiding the scams and guru courses in this space
This niche has an unusually high concentration of low-quality "get rich" courses — be selective.

This particular field has attracted an unusually high number of courses and 'gurus' promising guaranteed six-figure income with little real substance behind the claims — treating any income guarantee as a red flag protects you from wasting money and building a business on bad advice.

Real, sustainable income in this work comes from consistent execution for real clients over time, the same as any service business — not from a shortcut, script, or secret only a paid course will reveal.

Before paying for any program, look for verifiable specifics (real client results, a clear refund policy, direct answers to specific questions) rather than testimonials alone, which are easy to fabricate or cherry-pick.

take: Treat guaranteed-income courses as red flags.
